links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-4o urinary incontinence patient education responses (Çetinkaya-Uzun formula, Turkish)
links.effect: Most responses were classified as difficult, requiring university-level education; surgery-related topics were most complex. Understandability was high (peak 94.4%) but actionability was lower (surgical 68.2%).
links.quote: Most responses were classified as "difficult," requiring a university-level education to comprehend, with surgery-related topics being the most linguistically complex.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the performance, readability, actionability, and reliability of ChatGPT-4o responses to patient queries on urinary incontinence without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard comparison.
